research.title: Object Detection Robustness Under Image Degradation
bullets: Designed controlled experiments comparing pretrained object detectors under motion blur, compression artifacts, and reduced illumination using matched image subsets.
Analyzed precision and recall by object size and corruption severity, inspecting localization errors separately from missed detections.

research.title: Calibration of Semantic Segmentation Under Domain Shift
bullets: Designed evaluations of segmentation confidence across changing weather conditions, comparing uncalibrated predictions with temperature scaling fitted on held-out images.
Analyzed classwise calibration and boundary errors, examining whether confidence estimates remained informative for rare categories and visually ambiguous regions.

research.title: Training Data Composition for Fine-Grained Visual Recognition
bullets: Designed experiments varying class balance and augmentation policies for fine-grained image classification while holding model architecture and evaluation splits fixed.
Analyzed confusion patterns across visually similar categories and repeated training runs, documenting sensitivity to sampling choices and background variation.

work.title: Image Ingestion and Validation Utilities
bullets: Implemented assigned image ingestion utilities that checked file integrity, normalized metadata fields, and reported unsupported formats for downstream processing.
Added regression tests for malformed inputs and revised error handling based on bug reports from routine processing workflows.

projects.title: Local Feature Matching for Planar Image Alignment
bullets: Implemented local feature matching and robust homography estimation to align overlapping images, including filtering of ambiguous descriptor matches.
Compared feature configurations under rotation, scale changes, and illumination differences using reprojection error and visual inspection of alignment failures.

projects.title: Transfer Learning for Small-Sample Image Classification
bullets: Implemented frozen-feature classification and partial network fine-tuning with pretrained convolutional models, using consistent preprocessing and stratified training splits.
Compared validation accuracy, classwise recall, and training behavior across adaptation settings, inspecting errors associated with limited examples and background cues.

projects.title: Classical and Convolutional Image Denoising
bullets: Implemented median filtering, nonlocal means, and a convolutional denoising baseline for images with synthetically generated Gaussian and impulse noise.
Compared reconstruction quality across noise conditions using peak signal-to-noise ratio and structural similarity, examining edge preservation and texture smoothing.
